name: report__im_revision_tag_present
description: Every ReportData frame must carry the InteractionModelRevision marker at TLV context tag 0xFF (uint8 255). The emission site is internal/north/matter/im/read.go:343 where enc.PutUint(tlv.ContextTag(tagInteractionModelRevision), ...) appends the field after SuppressResponse. Apple Home strict-decodes this field and silently times the subscribe transaction out when it is absent, making the subscription appear to never complete from the controller side. This scenario locks that invariant: removing the enc.PutUint call at read.go:343 causes the harness to fail with 'tag 255 absent at TLV top level'.
